verdict.rationale: Apify's Crawlee library and Actor marketplace support full-website crawling (autoscaling, proxies, web crawling library) via docs, and its API/CLI allow single-request triggering of a crawler Actor. However, no direct evidence of a one-request 'crawl entire site' endpoint or dedicated whole-site crawler Actor is shown, and community feedback focuses on scraping speed/headless browser concerns rather than confirming full-site crawl completeness.
